notes.title: V1.22 Update inc. Steam Deck enhancements
notes.notes:
This update has improvements for Steam Deck, Steam Cloud, and other improvements/fixes. Enjoy!

- Steam Deck: Replaced "Click" in all tutorial text with "Tap".
- Steam Deck: If "Exit Game" is used via the Steam button the game will no longer say "Sorry the game didn't close properly last time." on next boot.
- Steam Deck: The on-screen keyboard will now appear automatically when the player is prompted to enter their name.
- Improved Steam Cloud support so that the first time you play on another device it will pick the first profile in the profile list instead of using a blank profile.
- Updated steam_api.dll and Steamstub.dll
- You can now pass in command line arguments (Steam Launch Options) to change the save data location as follows: SaveInDocuments or SaveInAppData or SaveInCGames or SaveInExeFolder
- Made sure that Skip Story button is always in the default state even if it was clicked before.
- Beating the game in hard mode will also award the achievement for normal mode as well.
- Fixed pixellated game background if loading the game in windowed mode then changing to borderless windowed mode via the in-game options.
- Changed Quit Hand button to Main Menu and updated the confirmation dialog to be clearer as to what happens.
- If you beat a combo/multiplier goal and then retry that hand, those completed goals will now be retained.
- In Hard mode you will be warned if you didn't get a perfect hand and clicked Next in case it was accidental.
- Any bows on cards not in play are now dimmed when the cards fly out at the start of hand e.g. on hand 7-5.
- Updated More Games dialog so that the Shadowhand button is now for Shadowhand Solitaire.
- Updated the news popup and news icon for Shadowhand Solitaire. We've done this because the best way to let our fans know about our new games is via cross-promotion from the older games and, as an indie micro-studio, every little thing we can do helps.

notes.title: Regency Solitaire II Multi-Language Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33035039/e7f0487fc5cbd3a045c7d50f6b0faab1798668ed.png[/img]

You can now [b]change language[/b] for Regency Solitaire II on Steam via the options screen.

Supported languages are: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese.

Note: at present we have no plans to officially support more languages because we are an indie microstudio. But we welcome fan translations.

Enjoy playing Regency Solitaire II in your chosen language!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137470/Regency_Solitaire_II/

notes.title: V1.21 Update!
notes.notes:
V1.21
- Defringed all the fonts to avoid slight white fringing when scaled up to a higher resolution.
- Borderless windowed mode now shows the same widescreen borders as full screen mode.
- Clicking Newsletter and More Games no longer closes the game to open the browser unless you are in full screen mode.
- Steam: Fixed an issue where running the game for the first time would show a dialog saying "Starting in Windowed mode due to incorrect shutdown."
- If the game is closed incorrectly (e.g. from a crash) it will now show a dialog on boot that allows the player to try out an OpenGL graphics driver instead of DirectX, which may work better on some Intel video cards.
- Fixed OpenGL windowed mode so it has a title bar.
- If the game fails to save data it now shows an error message advising players to exclude/whitelist the game/save data folder in their virus killer or One Drive.
- Changed Regency Solitaire II references to "Out Now".

Please note: Only the PC/Windows build has been updated.

notes.title: V1.20 Update
notes.notes:
V1.20
- Fixed Fan3 name as it was using Fan2 name.
- Prevented name entry with non-latin characters (e.g Russian) as it causes a problem with the save data.
- Added Borderless Window mode (checkbox is available on Options screen when Full Screen is NOT selected.)
- Game now defaults to Borderless Window mode on first install.
- The mouse over glow for bows is now correctly rotated.
- Stars are now correctly aligned when they stop flying onto the screen.
- Pressing the spacebar now also ends combos.
- Fixed an undo bug caused by rapidly clicking a normal card then unlocking a lock.
- Defringed card backs to avoid white outline around stock pile when running at a scaled resolution.
- Fixed powerup fill line graphical issue when running the game in a higher vertical resolution than 768 pixels.
- Added News Dialog and Icon for Regency Solitaire II Steam page.
- Updated version number in default.ini
- Other minor code enhancements.

Note: These updates only apply to the PC version.

- The More Games button now leads to the Steam page for Spooky Bonus which we just released. Please take a look, you'll love it.
- Fixed a rare undo bug which occurred if you rapidly clicked a normal card then a wildcard.
- Tweaked the screen clearing code so it works better at the edges of super-wide screens.

notes.title: V1.14 update includes minor fixes/improvements
notes.notes:
We just released an update with the following changes:

- Made game default to windowed mode on first run and after an incorrect shutdown.
- Fixed bug where sometimes a shuffle could result in a Regal lock being impossible to unlock.
- Added an underline on 6 and 9 plain cards to help indicate which way up they are.

Thanks to everyone who brought these issues to our attention so we could fix/improve them!

notes.title: V1.10 update includes minor fixes
notes.notes:
We just uploaded V1.10 which has the following minor fixes based on player feedback. Thanks everyone!

- Fixed bug where pressing Space during a combo would block further user input.
- Clicking anywhere on the Hand Complete screen will no longer move onto the next hand.
- Improved stability of unlocking multiple Steam achievements at once.

Next up: improved Widescreen code.
